# Devilon Studio

> Devilon Studio is a small engineering team that audits and hardens apps built with AI tools such as Lovable, Bolt, Replit and Cursor. An audit reviews security, access control, payments, data and deployment, and returns a written report in five working days with a fixed quote to fix what is found. Audits start from $490. We also automate manual work, build data pipelines and dashboards, and build web, mobile and AI features.

## Start here
- [App audit](https://www.devilonstudio.com/ai-to-production): A fixed-price production-readiness audit for apps built with AI tools. Written report, honest fix-or-rebuild recommendation, and a fixed quote.
- [Sample report](https://www.devilonstudio.com/sample-audit): See what a Devilon audit report looks like: findings, severity, fixes and effort, in an illustrative sample.
- [Contact](https://www.devilonstudio.com/contact): Tell us what you're trying to build, fix or automate. We'll figure out whether we're the right team for it.

## Services
- [Product Builds & MVPs](https://www.devilonstudio.com/services/product-engineering): SaaS products, platforms and dashboards, built AI-accelerated and engineer-owned from day one.
- [Mobile Apps](https://www.devilonstudio.com/services/mobile-apps): Cross-platform mobile apps with real backends, push notifications and store release support.
- [Operations Automation](https://www.devilonstudio.com/services/automation-internal-tools): Connect the tools you already use, remove the copy-paste, and put your data on one dashboard.
- [Data Engineering & Analytics](https://www.devilonstudio.com/services/data-engineering): Pipelines, databases and dashboards: get your data out of spreadsheets and silos, cleaned, connected and on a dashboard people trust.
- [AI Integration](https://www.devilonstudio.com/services/ai-integration): Assistants, document processing and search over your own data, wired into real systems with human handoff.
- [Agency Delivery](https://www.devilonstudio.com/services/white-label-delivery): Clients want software with someone accountable behind it. We own the technical side, under your brand.
- [3D & Interactive Experiences](https://www.devilonstudio.com/services/interactive-3d): Product visualization, interactive 3D on the web and configurators for products that are easier to show than describe.

## Questions and answers
### What do you need from me?
Read access to the code (a repo invite or an export), a short walkthrough of what the app does, and a test account. We don't need production data.

### Will you change my app during the audit?
No. The audit is read-only. Fixes are quoted separately and only start when you say yes.

### Do you sign an NDA?
Yes. We'll sign yours, or send ours, before you share any code.

### My app isn't built on Lovable or Bolt. Can you still audit it?
Yes. AI-built apps are our focus because they share predictable gaps, but the review applies to any web app on a stack we know: React, Next.js, Node, Python and Postgres.

### How is the price set?
Fixed, and shown as a "from" price ($490 and up) depending on the size of the app. We confirm the exact fee before we start.

### What happens after the report?
You decide. Fix it yourself using the report, ask us for a fixed quote, or hand it to another developer. The report is yours either way.

### Does an audit guarantee my app is secure?
No. It reviews the areas listed in the report and tells you what we found. No review can guarantee the absence of vulnerabilities.

We also automate manual work, build data pipelines and dashboards, and build web, mobile and AI features.

### Is your AI-built app ready for real users?
https://www.devilonstudio.com/ai-to-production
A fixed-price audit of apps built with Lovable, Bolt, Replit, Cursor and similar tools. We review access control, auth and secrets, payments, data and deployment, then give you a written report, a fix-or-rebuild recommendation and a fixed quote. From $490, report in five working days. An audit is not a guarantee that an app is free of vulnerabilities.
